entries.title: A crewmate on another computer can ask you to keep a key too
entries.body: A crewmate working on another of your computers can now ask you to keep a key, token or password it needs, the same way a crewmate on this computer asks. The same card with its masked field appears, and the value goes straight into Secrets on this computer. The crewmate hears only the key's name and reference. Before, it could only name the key in its report.
entries.noPicture: The card is the same one a crewmate on this computer raises; only who can ask changed.
